title: Alabama's 3rd Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Alabama's 3rd Congressional District pits 12-term Republican incumbent Mike Rogers, chair of the House Armed Services Committee, against Democratic nominee Lee McInnis, a disabled Army veteran and former defense intelligence professional. The district, which includes Anniston, Auburn, and Talladega, is heavily Republican (Cook Partisan Voting Index of R+23) and has not elected a Democrat since 2002. Rogers won the May 19 Republican primary with 83.2% of the vote, while McInnis ran unopposed in the Democratic primary. The race is rated 'Solid R' by Cook Political Report.
polling_note: No general election polls found for this race as of June 2026.

candidates.name: Mike Rogers
candidates.summary: Mike Rogers is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Alabama's 3rd Congressional District, first elected in 2002. He serves as Chair of the House Armed Services Committee and previously served as Ranking Member of both the Armed Services and Homeland Security Committees. Rogers is a conservative Republican who has consistently voted against major Democratic legislation and supported efforts to overturn the 2020 presidential election results.

candidates.name: Lee McInnis
candidates.summary: Lee McInnis is a disabled U.S. Army veteran and former Defense Intelligence Community professional running as the Democratic nominee for Alabama's 3rd Congressional District. He won the Democratic primary uncontested on May 19, 2026. McInnis has criticized incumbent Mike Rogers for being unresponsive to district constituents and has focused his campaign on healthcare, SNAP benefits, and accountable representation. He previously taught Communications and American Government courses after retiring from federal service.
